summary:
Fixed on base `5585401`, uncommitted.

- [t3-orchestration.mjs](tools/t3-orchestration.mjs:690) now reconstructs receipts before channel selection. Canonical `chainOrigin` preserves the earliest actual channel, original options, configured target, and origin catalog independently of job adjustment. Later receipts must share that origin.
- [t3-job-selection.test.mjs](tests/t3-job-selection.test.mjs:806) adds 12 regression tests covering verification, ceiling/no-effort jobs, omitted profiles, primary recovery, B→D refusals across catalog refresh, and forged origins.

Required command ran red-first, then green:

```text
node --test tests/t3-job-selection.test.mjs tests/t3-orchestration.test.mjs

Red:   # tests 150   # pass 140   # fail 10
Green: # tests 150   # pass 150   # fail 0
```

`git diff --check` passes. Helper remains under 1,000 lines at 928.

Model the Domain shaped `chainOrigin`. Fix Root Causes removed the adjustment gate. Test Behavior and Prove It Works shaped the public-API checks. Laziness Protocol kept the fix in the existing module.

Only the two owned files were edited. Other changes were preserved. Regeneration, full check, and final review remain parent-owned. No commits, installation, configuration changes, provider calls, or nested agents.
